name: @soulmaker/live
description: The Phantom-signing LIVE bridge (Sprint 107, Part 1 of 3). A default-BLOCKED live-mode policy (paper | readonly | live_prepare | live_canary), a typed ChainAdapter boundary (Solana mainnet is the ONLY live implementation; other chains are disabled stubs), a Phantom-signable canary REQUEST builder that wraps the real UNSIGNED txpreview.envelope.v1 (the backend NEVER custodies a key — Phantom signs and sends in the browser), a closed canary state machine, and a live-candidate decision. Live is DISABLED BY DEFAULT, micro-capped, manual-arm, and requires a human Phantom confirmation for every real transaction. No seed phrase, no private key, no backend signer, no profitability claim.
